review: Independent expectations recorded before V5 new adversarial tests
expectations: Closing binds current reconciliation, statement reviews, opening balances, active distinct humans and exact snapshot; stale final votes must not close.
Legitimate unpaid AP carries forward; cash/AP/accrual/reclassification cannot be altered to manufacture reconciliation.
Accrual reversal and invoice recognition use exact remaining original quantities and allocations atomically, including repeat/renamed source and final-cent cases.
Governed credits must preserve their original bill, approval, current authority and exact consumed amount before first send; possibly sent recovery retains original command/reservations.
Approved signed discount allocations preserve gross cost and contra-cost separately, exact net AP and exact credit reversal.
Returned bank cash restores only that cash liability; prior applied credit remains consumed. Replacement accounting must allocate original versus restored principal explicitly without reusing either.
External preview hash and authenticated subject cannot change before write; missing, stale or changed dependency/balance proof prevents POST and cannot resolve unrelated holds.
B4 export must derive the approved action/application and exact posted journal from authenticated backend; raw client statements cannot authorize accounting writes.
